cohort: Deliveries to mothers aged between 10 and 24 years from January 2012 to January 2013 at selected health facilities in Kawambwa and Mansa districts of Luapula, Zambia (N = 2795).
finding: While initially adolescent mothers faced a higher risk for several adverse obstetric and perinatal outcomes, after adjusting for potential confounders the association between maternal age and these outcomes diminished.
